Passively grants +30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.

Shotgun Kills restore Melee Ability Energy.
10% Rank-And-File | 25% Anything Else

If your Void Melee Ability is Charged:
Shotgun Kills activate Void Overshield and consume all of your Melee Energy.

Passively grants 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.

If your Void Melee Ability is Charged:
Shotgun Kills consume your Melee Ability and grant a 45 HP Void Overshield.

Shotgun Kills restore Melee Ability Energy based on <link enemy rank [https://d2clarity.page.link/combatant] />.
• 5%: Tier 1 Minors
• 9%: Tier 2 Minors, Tier 1 Elites
• 10%: Enemy Players
• 13%: Tier 3 Minors, Tier 2 Elites
• 25%: Tier 4 Minors, Tier 3-4 Elites, Minibosses, Bosses

Passively grants ? Reload Speed and 30 Airborne Effectiveness to Shotguns.

While Void Overshield is active:
• Shotgun deal <pve 35% /> <pvp [10%] /> Increased Damage
• Shotgun Kills refresh Void Overshield duration to ? seconds

While on a Void Subclass, rapid Shotgun Kills or Killing a Powerful Enemy (testing required) with a Shotgun grants a Void Overshield and starts Health Regeneration.
